subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
If each sample is quantized into 128 levels, how 
many binary digits (bits) would be required to store 
the three minutes performance? 
 
(a)  8.125 × 105 bits 
(b)  7.28 × 108 bits 
 
(c)  3.98 × 107 bits 
(d)  5.688 × 106 bits 
 
Common Data For 21 and 22 : 
A voltage of 1-volt rms is applied at the sending end of a 
telephone cable of length 1000 meters. The attenuation in 
the cable is 1 dB/m.
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-05 (ECE/IN).
